desc:
👋 Welcome to Farm Mobs with Anime!

How to Play:
🎲 Roll for insane anime characters
💥 Build an anime army to farm mobs
💵 Sell mob drops to earn money
⬆️ Upgrade your spawner to farm better mobs
🍀 Collect rare anime characters and build the strongest team!

🤑 Money generates while you are offline
👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
